Topic 2.1

Staggered Away Screens

Stagger whenever possible. On post hits, the passer and the next closest teammate stagger away, Davidson Wildcats style.

Coach Kevin Keto·7 min·Not viewed
Builds on1.1Breakdown Rules

Objective

By the end of this topic you can:

  • 01Name a staggered away screen and recognize it on film, Davidson Wildcats style.
  • 02Stagger whenever possible when we pass and screen away.
  • 03On a post hit, know your job if you are the passer or the next closest teammate.

Know the action

Key terms

Staggered Away Screens

Also called Davidson Wildcats

Two teammates screen away from the ball, one after the other. When the initial action breaks down, we stagger whenever possible.

Tap to see it
Staggered Away Screens

On post hits, the passer and the next closest teammate stagger away.

Tap to flip back

Stagger rules

Principles

  1. 01
    Stagger whenever possible
    Looks likeWhen you pass and screen away and a teammate is close, the two of you set the screens together, one after the other.
  2. 02
    On post hits, passer and next closest teammate stagger away
    Looks likeThe ball goes into the post, and the passer and the next closest teammate go screen away together instead of watching.

Post hit stagger

Play cards

[Diagram]

Post Hit Stagger Away

  1. 01Hit the post.
  2. 02The passer screens away.
  3. 03The next closest teammate screens away with the passer to make the stagger.
